veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.voor: 'n wye draai om die boom geloop
veranderings.na: 'n wye draai om die boom gemaak
veranderings.rede: 'n Draai loop' is also a colloquial euphemism for going to the toilet; 'n wye draai maak' is the standard idiom for giving something a wide berth.

veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.na: en gee vir hom die spanner aan
veranderings.rede: Says who she passes the spanner to; 'aangee' without a recipient reads as unfinished.
